learning_outcomes.text: Selection, installation, operation, design and maintenance of systems in the field of mechanical engineering
Selection, operation, design of various machine elements used in machine construction

syllabus_topics: Bearings. Sliding bearings. Rolling bearings. Lubricants used for bearing lubrication.
Stress distribution in lateral fillet welds
Calibration of dynamic and limiting wrenches
Study of functional parameters of helical springs
Friction losses in single-row radial ball bearings. Friction losses in radial sliding bearings
Installation of initial tension in a belt drive. Friction coefficient in transmission belts. Control of geometric parameters of V-belt drives
Tightening torque and friction coefficients in bolted joints. Stiffness of a bolted joint with initial tightening
Design of a single-stage or two-stage speed reducer
teaching_methods: Lectures with video projector and blackboard

assessment_methods.method: Laboratory tests and verification of conclusions
Project work (calculation, assembly and execution drawings for a speed reducer)

assessment_rules: The minimum passing grade for the written exam is 5. Minimum knowledge required for passing the discipline includes describing the function, calculation, selection, and design of a machine element from those presented in the course.
